# Synerax

> Synerax is a technology partner that delivers AI-powered applications, cloud infrastructure, enterprise software, DevOps and digital transformation as scalable, secure, future-ready solutions.

## About

Synerax is a team of engineers, designers and AI specialists, founded and headquartered in Noida, India. Its mission is to make enterprise-grade technology accessible to every business, regardless of size or location. What started as a small development shop has grown into a full-service digital engineering company serving clients across 20+ countries, from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 enterprises. Cross-functional teams bring expertise in software engineering, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity and cloud architecture to every engagement.

Page: https://synerax.in/about

### A Technology Studio Built for Scale

We're a team of engineers, designers, and AI specialists building the digital infrastructure of tomorrow — headquartered in Noida, India, serving clients across 20+ countries.

### From a Small Studio to a Global Engineering Partner

Synerax was founded in Noida, India with a singular mission: to make enterprise-grade technology accessible to every business, regardless of size or location.

What started as a small development shop has grown into a full-service digital engineering company serving clients across 20+ countries — from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 enterprises.

Our cross-functional teams bring deep expertise in software engineering, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and cloud architecture to every engagement.

- **Global Reach, Local Expertise** — Serving 20+ countries while staying rooted in India's world-class engineering talent.
- **98% Client Satisfaction** — We don't just deliver projects — we build partnerships that last for years.
- **Cutting-Edge by Default** — We invest in R&D so our clients always have access to the latest technology innovations.

### Mission

Delivering secure, scalable technology solutions that simplify complexity and accelerate digital transformation — enabling organisations of every size to compete at the highest level. We believe the best technology should be accessible, not just to Fortune 500s, but to every ambitious business ready to grow.

### Vision

To become the most trusted technology partner for enterprises undergoing digital transformation — recognised globally for our depth of expertise, quality of delivery, and long-term client relationships. A world where technology removes barriers instead of creating them — that's the future Synerax is building toward.

## Services

All solutions: https://synerax.in/solutions

### Web & Enterprise Applications

Page: https://synerax.in/solutions/web-enterprise-applications

Custom web platforms and enterprise-grade applications, engineered to scale. High-performance front ends, deep systems integration, and architecture that holds up as your business grows.

We build web platforms and internal applications that sit at the centre of how a business operates — order systems, customer portals, operations consoles, partner networks. Every build starts from the integration map and the load profile, not from a template. The result is software that is fast under real traffic, secure by design, and straightforward for your own engineers to extend once we hand it over.

- High-Performance Web Apps — React and Next.js applications with server rendering, streaming, and aggressive caching for sub-second interaction.
- Enterprise Integrations — Reliable connections into ERP, CRM, billing, and legacy systems with retries, idempotency, and full audit trails.
- Scalable Architecture — Domain-driven service boundaries and data models designed for the traffic you will have, not just today.
- Secure by Design — Threat modelling, least-privilege access, dependency auditing, and secrets management from the first commit.
- API & Data Layer — REST and GraphQL surfaces over PostgreSQL, with schema versioning and predictable migrations.
- Design Systems — Typed, tested component libraries so every team ships a consistent interface without re-solving the basics.

### DevSecOps & FinOps

Page: https://synerax.in/solutions/devsecops-finops

Secure automated delivery and cloud cost efficiency, together. Pipelines that scan as they ship, infrastructure as code, and spend you can actually explain.

Delivery speed and cloud spend are the same problem viewed from two ends. We build pipelines that carry security scanning inline rather than as a gate at the end, and we instrument the cloud bill so every team can see what their services actually cost. Infrastructure is defined in code, releases are automated and reversible, and rightsizing runs continuously instead of once a quarter when finance asks.

- CI/CD Pipelines — GitHub Actions and GitLab CI pipelines with parallel stages, artefact promotion, and one-command rollback.
- Security Scanning In-Pipeline — SAST, DAST, dependency and secrets scanning that blocks on real findings instead of drowning teams in noise.
- Infrastructure as Code — Terraform modules with remote state, policy checks, plan review, and drift detection across environments.
- Automated Testing & Release — Unit, integration, and end-to-end suites wired to progressive delivery — canary, blue/green, feature flags.
- Cloud Cost Visibility — Per-team and per-service cost attribution through AWS Cost Explorer and Kubecost, with budgets and alerts.
- Rightsizing & Optimisation — Continuous instance, storage, and commitment analysis that turns waste into a tracked, closable backlog.

### Cybersecurity Solutions

Page: https://synerax.in/solutions/cybersecurity

Enterprise security, compliance, and threat defense. A 24/7 SOC, zero-trust architecture, and audit-ready controls that hold up under real scrutiny.

We treat security as an operating capability, not a document. That means a monitored perimeter, identity-first access control, tested response runbooks, and evidence collected continuously rather than assembled the week before an audit. Compliance work — SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA — is mapped onto the controls you already run, so certification becomes a reporting exercise instead of a second system to maintain.

- 24/7 Security Operations — Continuous monitoring with tuned detections, triage, and an escalation path that reaches a human every time.
- Zero-Trust Architecture — Identity-first access, network segmentation, and continuous verification instead of a trusted internal network.
- Penetration Testing — Application, infrastructure, and social engineering testing against your live environment, with retest included.
- Compliance & Certification — SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and HIPAA programmes mapped onto controls you already operate.
- Incident Response — Tested runbooks, forensics, containment, and post-incident review that closes the loop back into engineering.
- Vulnerability Management — Continuous scanning across code, images, and infrastructure with risk-ranked, owner-assigned remediation.

### Agentic AI Solutions

Page: https://synerax.in/solutions/agentic-ai

Autonomous LLM agents and AI workflows for your business. Custom pipelines, retrieval over your own data, and agents that complete work rather than just answer questions.

We build AI systems around a specific job to be done — triaging a queue, drafting a document set, reconciling records, answering from your own corpus. Each one is scoped, evaluated against a held-out set, and shipped with guardrails and a human escalation path. Retrieval runs over your data with access control intact, and every agent action is logged so you can audit what was done and why.

- Custom LLM Pipelines — Task-specific chains with prompt versioning, evaluation sets, and regression tests before anything ships.
- Autonomous Agents — Multi-step agents with tool access, memory, budget limits, and a defined hand-off to a human.
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation — Vector search over your documents with chunking strategy, re-ranking, and row-level permissions preserved.
- Natural Language Processing — Classification, extraction, summarisation, and intent detection tuned on your domain language.
- ML Systems in Production — Training, serving, monitoring, and retraining loops with drift detection and rollback.
- Guardrails & Observability — Every action logged and replayable, with policy checks, cost ceilings, and evaluation dashboards.

### Cloud Engineering & Migration

Page: https://synerax.in/solutions/cloud-engineering-migration

Cloud architecture, migration, and optimization. AWS, Azure and GCP environments built as code, moved without drama, and tuned for both availability and cost.

Migration work fails on cutover, not on design. We plan in waves, keep a working rollback at every step, and prove each workload in its new home before the old one is retired. What lands is a cloud environment defined entirely in Terraform, running on Kubernetes where that earns its keep, with availability targets and cost guardrails set before the first workload moves.

- Cloud Architecture — Well-architected designs across AWS, Azure, and GCP with clear network, identity, and data boundaries.
- Migration & Cutover — Wave-based migration with dependency mapping, dual-run validation, and a tested rollback at each step.
- Infrastructure as Code — Terraform modules with remote state, policy-as-code, and environment parity from dev through production.
- Kubernetes Platforms — Cluster design, autoscaling, self-healing workloads, and a paved path for teams to deploy onto.
- Cost Optimisation — Rightsizing, commitment planning, and storage tiering measured against a baseline you agree up front.
- High Availability — Multi-AZ and multi-region designs with tested failover and a documented recovery objective.

### Observability, SRE & Production Engineering

Page: https://synerax.in/solutions/observability-sre

Reliability engineering and full-stack observability. Metrics, logs and traces joined up, service levels that mean something, and an on-call rotation that people can live with.

Observability is not three tools bolted together. We instrument services so metrics, logs, and traces share the same identifiers, then build the handful of dashboards and alerts that actually correspond to customer pain. On top of that sits the operating practice: service level objectives with error budgets, an incident process that produces learning rather than blame, and a sustainable on-call rotation.

- Full-Stack Observability — Metrics, logs, and traces correlated by shared identifiers across every service in the request path.
- SLOs & Error Budgets — Service levels defined from customer journeys, with error budgets that govern release pace.
- Incident Response — Defined roles, runbooks, comms templates, and blameless review that feeds fixes back into the backlog.
- On-Call Engineering — Rotation design, alert tuning, and escalation policies built so the pager only fires for real customer impact.
- Performance Engineering — Latency budgets, profiling, and load testing against realistic traffic ahead of peak events.
- Instrumentation & Pipelines — OpenTelemetry instrumentation with sampling strategy and retention that keeps the bill predictable.

### Application Modernization

Page: https://synerax.in/solutions/application-modernization

Legacy systems re-architected for the cloud era. Monoliths decomposed, platforms replaced, and technical debt paid down without stopping delivery.

Rewrites fail because they ask a business to wait. We modernise incrementally — carve a seam, stand up the replacement behind an API, move traffic, retire the old path. Each step ships and each step is reversible. The end state is an API-first, containerised system your team can deploy independently, with the technical debt register visibly shorter than when we started.

- Monolith Decomposition — Domain seams identified from real call graphs, then extracted service by service behind stable contracts.
- Re-Platforming — Legacy runtimes and databases moved onto supported, modern equivalents without a delivery freeze.
- API-First Design — Contracts specified and mocked before implementation, so consumers can move in parallel with providers.
- Containerization — Reproducible images, dependency pinning, and a deployment path that behaves identically in every environment.
- Strangler Migration — Traffic shifted route by route behind a facade, with the old path kept live until the new one is proven.
- Technical Debt Reduction — Debt inventoried, risk-ranked, and burnt down on a schedule alongside feature work rather than instead of it.

### IT Service Management (ITSM)

Page: https://synerax.in/solutions/itsm

Streamlined IT operations and service delivery. ITIL-aligned processes, a service desk people actually use, and SLA governance backed by real reporting.

Most ITSM programmes fail by adding process faster than they remove friction. We start from the ticket data — where time is actually lost — and design the smallest process that fixes it, then automate the repetitive parts. What you get is an ITIL-aligned operation with clear incident, change, and problem paths, a service catalogue that reflects reality, and SLA reporting your stakeholders trust.

- ITIL-Aligned Processes — Incident, change, problem, and request management sized to your organisation rather than copied wholesale.
- Service Desk — Single point of intake with skills-based routing, self-service portal, and a knowledge base that stays current.
- Incident Management — Priority matrices, escalation paths, and major-incident handling with communications built into the process.
- Change & Problem Management — Change advisory workflow with risk scoring, plus root-cause analysis that removes repeat incidents.
- Automation — Runbook automation for the repetitive majority — provisioning, resets, access requests, routine checks.
- SLA Governance & Reporting — Service levels defined with the business, measured continuously, and reviewed on a fixed cadence.
